The fix is to cast `txn_amount` as `amount`. The error message is odd, but it is consistent with the column not being found (DuckDB may suggest alias-based resolution). The `CAST(amount ...)` is the problem.

The fix replaces only silver_transactions and keeps the output columns unchanged.
